notes: If you ask for a GIF of a moment that is past the end of your clip, Crisp now tells you the clip is shorter than that instead of quietly making a GIF of the whole thing. It used to depend on how you phrased it: "make a gif starting at 40s" was caught, but "gif starting 40s", "gif of 40s onwards" and "a gif of the 40s mark" were not, and you got a file back for a moment that does not exist. Asking for a GIF of a certain LENGTH still works exactly as before — a 40-second GIF of a short clip is still the whole clip. Nothing got slower.
